sections.content: A subquery is a query inside another query — in WHERE, FROM, or SELECT. They answer "rows matching a condition computed from other rows".
IN checks membership: WHERE id IN (SELECT ...). EXISTS tests existence efficiently. Correlated subqueries reference outer rows (slower).
Key points: prefer JOINs when possible (usually clearer/faster), but subqueries shine for "exists" checks and single-value lookups.
